conditions: KIM chemistry is capped by syndicate rank (Liked needs Rank 3), but chemistry earned while capped is kept, so chat daily from the start.
Do the daily KIM conversation before ranking up or gifting; either can end that day's pending conversation.
bonuses: Treasures pay Big Bytes Pizza 2,500, Argon Burger Meal 1,500, the other six 750 each. After Rank 5, Temporal Archimedea pays 15,000 for all three missions.
Parallax's air support charge pings Hex Treasures on the map.
